name: OKC_XPRT_QUESTION_ORDERS
description: This entity stores the order of the questions to be displayed at runtime. This is an intersection entity between templates and questions.

columns.name: SEQUENCE_NUM
columns.description: The order in which questions on the template would be displayed when the user invokes contract expert during contract authoring

columns.name: MANDATORY_FLAG
columns.description: To indicate if a question need to be mandatory on run time UI.

columns.name: RESPONSE_REQUIRED
columns.description: Indicates if a reponse is required during runtime

columns.name: QUESTION_RULE_STATUS
columns.description: Indicate the status of the rule in which the question is used. If the question is used in multiple rules, the highest status will shown. The status priority is: ACTIVE, DRAFT.

columns.name: RUNTIME_AVAILABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether the question is available at runtime. This flag will be null or N when record is created. Updated to Y when a template is successfully published in Oracle Configurator. Questions Order read only regions will render the 'Shown in Runtime' from this field

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: DISPLAY_NUMBER
columns.description: To indicate the display number of the question in the Runtime UI.

columns.name: DEFAULT_VALUE
columns.description:
This column stores question default value.
A CLOB type is required to support Text Area and Multi Select types.
